map.截面积与流速之积。: The product of cross-sectional area and velocity.
map.体积流量公式：Q = A * v，A 为过流断面面积、v 为断面平均流速；Q 单: Volume flow rate formula: Q = A * v, where A is the flow cross-sectional area and v the mean velocity over that section; Q is given in m³/s, and multiplying by 1000 gives L/s while multiplying by 3600 gives m³/h; the area can also be recovered from the flow rate and velocity as A = Q/v.
map.Q = A*v。例：D=0.1 m 管 v=1 m/s，Q=pi*0.05^2*: Q = A*v. Example: a pipe of D=0.1 m with v=1 m/s gives Q=pi*0.05^2*1=7.85e-3 m³/s=28.3 m³/h.
map.m3/s、L/s、m3/h 常用，注意换算。: m³/s, L/s and m³/h are common, so watch the conversions.
